summary: Retest of iteration 6 HIGH-priority bug (Alert.alert with buttons silently dropped on react-native-web). Fix (window.confirm on web, Alert.alert on native) VERIFIED WORKING. All 5 requested checks pass: (1) accept-confirm fires DELETE 204 and removes card, (2) dismiss-confirm fires NO DELETE and card stays, (3) ouvrier sees 0 delete buttons but 3 share buttons, (4) DB clean (3 events remain, no Iter6/TEST_ leftovers), (5) Hub CTA smoke — hub-open-session renders on events w/o active session and opens Pasteur with auto-open modal. Deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents style warnings still present in console (non-blocking, unrelated to this fix).

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN 0.75+ deprecation warnings
critical_code_review_comments: confirmDelete() branch on Platform.OS === 'web' correctly uses window.confirm with typeof window !== 'undefined' guard — safe for SSR. Native path retains Alert.alert with destructive style.
DELETE mutation triggers query invalidation on success; UI updates within ~1s of 204 response.
seed_data_creation: None. Test 2 consumed 1 seeded event ('Culte spécial - Anciens') via legitimate delete flow — 3 events remain, all clean. Spec permitted '4 or fewer'. Main agent may re-seed if backend restart doesn't restore it automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete-confirm on evenements list is stable on web. For future Playwright tests involving window.confirm: DO NOT rely on page.on('dialog', ...) because click() promise hangs 30s. Instead override window.confirm via page.evaluate BEFORE the click: `await page.evaluate(() => { window.__confirmCalls=[]; window.confirm = (m)=>{ window.__confirmCalls.push(m); return true; }; })` then click and inspect __confirmCalls afterwards. This gives deterministic control and no timeouts.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 6 bug RCA (already fixed): react-native-web silently drops the buttons argument of Alert.alert, so the destructive 'Supprimer' callback was never invoked. Iteration 7 fix uses window.confirm on Platform.OS === 'web' which returns synchronously true/false, wired to deleteMut.mutate. Confirmed via captured confirm message 'Supprimer « Culte spécial - Anciens » ?' + DELETE /api/evenements/{id} → 204 → card removed.
